decoderDesign.body: accept captured attachment MIME only for pinned HTTPS endpoint; enforce size cap and fatal UTF8 JSON decode; reject HTML, invalid envelope, DATA non-array, row non-object, unknown schema changes
decoderDesign.identity: require hmpg_addr URL exact host/path, no credentials/nondefault port/fragment, single numeric cultcode; duplicate ID quarantine; never hash title as ID
decoderDesign.dates: require finite integer epoch-ms and valid range; convert KST; compare date text; quarantine reversed interval; do not swap silently
decoderDesign.nulls: distinguish null/empty/unknown vs free; IS_FREE null => unknown admission, no invented coordinates
decoderDesign.text: never inject raw markup; escape text, retain raw evidence separately
decoderDesign.links: validate destination scheme and host, prohibit credentials and unsafe schemes; do not server-fetch arbitrary org_link; HTTP content URLs require separate HTTPS verification or placeholder, never blanket rewrite
decoderDesign.status: snapshot has no explicit cancellation/deletion/sourceStatus; do not infer active or deleted from presence/absence; owner must establish downstream contract
decoderDesign.compatibility: current seoul.ts expects culturalEventInfo RESULT/list_total_count/row uppercase strings, max1000/page; cannot feed DESCRIPTION/DATA lowercase numeric full download directly
